entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A former Jeskai monk, trained by Narset, who swore himself to the rakshasa Ebirri and became Sidisi's chief advisor and personal enforcer in the Sultai.

entities.name: Ebirri
entities.description: A feline rakshasa demon who bound himself to Taigam as his true master and kills the Jeskai assassins with dark magic.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: The khan of the Sultai, a brood tyrant who sends Taigam to carry out her decrees.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: The khan of the Jeskai who once trained Taigam and called him one of her most adept students.

entities.name: Kishla Elder
entities.description: An elderly leader of the town of Kishla who kneels to Taigam and loses a child.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A decadent clan with undead servants and ancient deals with rakshasa, whose territory includes the Marang River.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A monastic clan led by Narset, some of whose zealot monks attack Taigam.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: Undead servants of the Sultai, some former villagers, who pull Taigam's ship through the water.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Powerful demons whose age-old deals are the source of much Sultai power and undead.

entities.name: Kishla
entities.description: A small stilted town on the Marang River in debt to the Sultai.

entities.name: Marang River
entities.description: The river flowing through Sultai territory and around their palaces.

entities.name: Purugir
entities.description: The trading post near the Salt Road where Taigam met Ebirri.

events.summary: Taigam's golden ship arrives at Kishla, pulled by undead sibsig, to collect the town's debt for Sidisi.
events.quote: A human Sultai enforcer lowered the gangplank for the leaders to enter the ship and head belowdecks.

events.summary: Flashback: Taigam, taught by Narset, leaves the Jeskai and travels to Purugir seeking work, drawing Sultai interest.
events.quote: He didn't set out to join another clan.

events.summary: Flashback: the rakshasa Ebirri offers Taigam power in the Sultai, and Taigam pledges his life to the rakshasa.
events.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

events.summary: Flashback: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi, who sends him to enforce her decrees, watched by Ebirri.
events.quote: Taigam rose to chief advisor of Sidisi, the kahn of the Sultai.

events.summary: Taigam humiliates an elder of Kishla, then has a guard take one of his three children.
Jeskai monks kill the departing guard and burst into the ship to assassinate Taigam.
events.quote: Three human Jeskai monks stood with clenched fists.

events.summary: Ebirri fights the monks and kills two while Taigam, freeing himself, stabs the rakshasa, who then crushes a monk's head; Ebirri reminds Taigam he owns him.
Taigam learns that Narset sent the surviving monk, has the monk crushed, and suspects the monks were zealots acting without her.
events.quote: They were zealots, most likely acting without her knowledge.

events.summary: Taigam resolves to handle the Jeskai threat himself and has the dead monks sized for golden uniforms.
events.quote: Taigam signaled the sibsig to keep the boat moving as he began to size the intact dead monks for golden uniforms.

relations.note: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.
relations.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

relations.note: Taigam is Sidisi's chief advisor and personal enforcer.
relations.quote: Taigam executed Sidisi's rule throughout Sultai territory

relations.note: Narset trained Taigam when he was Jeskai.
relations.quote: He even had the honor of being trained by the khan of the Jeskai, Narset.

relations.note: Sidisi is the khan of the Sultai.
relations.quote: Taigam rose to chief advisor of Sidisi, the kahn of the Sultai.

relations.note: Narset is khan of the Jeskai.
Jeskai zealots try to assassinate him.
relations.quote: I'm sure there are still many among the Jeskai who would like to see a mistake like me removed from the picture.

relations.note: Ebirri crushes and chokes the Jeskai assassins.
relations.quote: Ebirri crushed it, exploding brain and skull all over the cabin.
